title: Two AI Security Winners to Own Now
excerpt: The AI boom often centers on productivity – doing more and doing it faster. But AI also allows for automated attacks at record speeds.
content_html:
So, cybersecurity matters more than ever. And market players know this.

At MoneyFlows, we help investors by uncovering the leading companies in each major AI frontier. And right now, institutional money flows are highlighting two clear AI security winners.

Elite AI Cybersecurity Stocks

The first cybersecurity stock to own in the age of AI is Fortinet (FTNT). This $120 billion market capitalization company delivers cybersecurity solutions to enterprises, governments, and small businesses.

The stock doubled this year; now it trades at a forward price-earnings ratio of 44.2:

Its latest earnings report showed per-share earnings of $0.90, which easily beat estimates of $0.75.

For 2026, Fortinet projects EPS of $3.44 at the midpoint, versus prior guidance of $3.13. Equally nice, revenues guidance was raised to a midpoint of $8.1 billion against estimates of $7.81 billion.

As it stands, fiscal 2027's EPS should hit $3.76. And by 2028, EPS climbs to $4.28.

Few companies have such a strong fundamental outlook.

This is why FTNT has been under extreme inflows (left) since early May, beginning at around $90 per share:

The blue bars (right) indicate the discrete times when FTNT was an elite stock in our data.

Great stocks are powered higher by unwavering institutional support. MoneyFlows spots these opportunities early.

The next best cybersecurity stock to own in the AI era is Palo Alto (PANW). The $325 billion market cap firm protects networks by stopping cyberattacks.

Like Fortinet, the stock has rewarded shareholders handsomely, gaining over 110% in 2026. That said, it's more expensive, trading at a lofty 93 forward P/E:

However, the fundamentals support this valuation.

Third-quarter earnings showed the company's Next-Generation Security ARR is targeting $8.925 billion in sales. That would reflect year-over-year revenue growth of nearly 60%.

Of course, Big Money has been piling into PANW shares well ahead of this rosy outlook. A wall of inflows elevated the stock from $196 to its latest price of $387:

And note the handful of Outlier signals (right) revealing this is a top choice in our data. This is a quality name with institutional support.

Why? Because institutions tend to understand business trends ahead of the print.

因此，网络安全比以往任何时候都更加重要。 市场参与者都知道这一点。

在 MoneyFlows，我们通过发现每个主要人工智能领域的领先公司来帮助投资者。 目前，机构资金流向凸显了两个明显的人工智能安全赢家。

精英人工智能网络安全股票

人工智能时代第一只值得持有的网络安全股票是 Fortinet (FTNT)。 这家市值 1200 亿美元的公司为企业、政府和小型企业提供网络安全解决方案。

该股今年翻了一番；现在它的远期市盈率为 44.2：

其最新收益报告显示每股收益为 0.90 美元，轻松超过 0.75 美元的预期。

Fortinet 预计 2026 年每股收益中位数为 3.44 美元，而之前的指导值为 3.13 美元。 同样令人高兴的是，收入指引从预期的 78.1 亿美元上调至 81 亿美元的中点。

按照目前的情况，2027 财年的每股收益应达到 3.76 美元。 到 2028 年，每股收益将攀升至 4.28 美元。

很少有公司拥有如此强劲的基本面前景。

这就是为什么 FTNT 自 5 月初以来一直处于极度资金流入（左）的原因，起始价约为每股 90 美元：

蓝色条（右）表示 FTNT 成为我们数据中的精英股票的离散时间。

优质股票在坚定不移的机构支持下走高。 MoneyFlows 很早就发现了这些机会。

人工智能时代下一个值得持有的最佳网络安全股票是 Palo Alto (PANW)。 这家市值 3250 亿美元的公司通过阻止网络攻击来保护网络。

与 Fortinet 一样，该股票也给股东带来了丰厚的回报，2026 年涨幅超过 110%。 也就是说，它的价格更高，远期市盈率高达 93：

然而，基本面支持这一估值。

第三季度收益显示，该公司的下一代安全 ARR 目标销售额为 89.25 亿美元。 这将反映出近 60% 的同比收入增长。

当然，早在这一乐观前景出现之前，大资金就已经大量涌入 PANW 股票。 大量资金流入使该股从 196 美元上涨至最新的 387 美元：

请注意少数异常信号（右）表明这是我们数据中的首选。 这是一个有机构支持的优质名称。
